FirstGraderBoy.sheet: KM-C01_first_grade_boy (its four views, Gemini; its model and rig, meshy.ai)
FirstGraderBoy.parts_caption: Its outfit parts recoloured as the game dresses them (ModelOutfit): the shirt, the legwear and the randoseru take the palette; the yellow cap, hair, skin, socks and shoes stay

motion_notes.stroll: Walking: WalkerAnimator's stroll, 24 frames a stride (1.3 s at 0.9 m/s)
motion_notes.chat: Chatting when stopped: hands going, nodding (one nod, 3.3 s)
motion_notes.wait: Waiting at the kerb: a slow sway of the head and body (15.7 s)
